sets.title: Pure or Meaning-Changing?
sets.description: Distinguish pure perfectivizers from meaning-changing prefixes
sets.descriptionRussian: Различите чистовидовые приставки и приставки со значением

items.prompt: делать → сделать. Pure perfectivizer or meaning-changing?
items.promptEnglish: Does с- change the meaning of делать?
items.hint: Сделать = finished doing. Same core meaning as делать.
items.explanation: Pure perfectivizer: с- + делать = сделать (completed doing). No new meaning.

items.prompt: писать → записать. Pure perfectivizer or meaning-changing?
items.promptEnglish: Does за- just perfectivize or add new meaning?
items.hint: Записать = write DOWN, not just 'finish writing.'
items.explanation: Meaning-changing: за- + писать = записать (write down). New meaning, not pure aspect.

items.prompt: Я _____ немного и ушёл. (I sat for a while and left.)
items.hint: по- = for a while / a bit.
items.explanation: По- with activity verbs = 'for a while': посидел (sat for a bit).

items.prompt: Она вдруг _____. (She suddenly started crying.)
items.explanation: За- (inceptive) = begin: заплакала (started crying). Meaning-changing prefix.

items.prompt: читать → перечитать means:
items.promptEnglish: What does the prefix пере- add?
items.explanation: Пере- = again/re-: перечитать (reread). Meaning-changing prefix.

items.prompt: ехать → доехать means:
items.hint: до- = up to, reach the destination.
items.explanation: До- = up to/reach: доехать (reach a destination by driving). Meaning-changing.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort: pure perfectivizer or meaning-changing prefix?

items.prompt: Мы _____ к друзьям по дороге домой. (We dropped by our friends' on the way home.)
items.hint: за- with motion verbs = drop by.
items.explanation: За- (motion) = drop by/stop in: заехали (dropped by).

items.prompt: Он _____ весь торт один! (He ate the whole cake by himself!)
items.promptEnglish: He ate up the entire cake.
items.hint: с- here = completely, all of it.
items.explanation: С- = completely (with eating): съел (ate up the whole thing).

items.prompt: Мы _____ немного в парке. (We walked for a while in the park.)
items.explanation: По- = for a while: погуляли (walked/strolled for a bit).

items.prompt: Она _____ все старые письма. (She reread all the old letters.)
items.promptEnglish: She reread all the old letters.
items.explanation: Пере- = again: перечитала (reread). Not the first reading.

items.prompt: Ребёнок _____ от матери. (The child ran away from the mother.)
items.explanation: У- = away from: убежал (ran away).

items.prompt: Собака _____ в дом. (The dog ran into the house.)
items.explanation: В- = into/inside: вбежала (ran into the house).

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ книгу. (read to the end, completed)
minimalPairs.explanation: Про- = completed the whole thing: прочитал (read to the end).

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ книгу. (read for a little while)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He read the book for a bit.
minimalPairs.explanation: По- = for a while: почитал (read for a bit, didn't necessarily finish).

minimalPairs.context: Она _____ песню. (sang a song to the end)
minimalPairs.explanation: С- (pure pf) = completed: спела (sang the whole song).

sets.title: The по- Prefix
sets.description: Master the 'for a while' meaning of по-

blanks: Давай _____ в шахматы! (Let's play chess for a while!)
Он _____ и ушёл. (He talked for a bit and left.)
Мы _____ в кафе и пошли домой. (We sat in the cafe for a while and went home.)
Я хочу _____ перед сном. (I want to read for a bit before bed.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: по- = for a while/a bit (limited duration)
hints: Let's play for a while: по- + играть. First person plural future.
Talked for a bit: по- + говорить. Past tense masculine.
Sat for a while: по- + сидеть. Past tense plural.
To read for a bit: по- + читать. Infinitive form.
explanations: Поиграем: по- + играть = play for a while. First person plural pf future: поиграем.
Поговорил: по- + говорить = talk for a while. He talked briefly, then left.
Посидели: по- + сидеть = sit for a while. They sat for a bit, then went home.
Почитать: по- + читать = read for a while. Infinitive: I want to read a little.

items.prompt: Дети _____ на улице и вернулись домой. (The children played outside for a while and came back.)
items.explanation: По- = limited duration: поиграли (played for a while). Not проиграли (lost) or выиграли (won).

items.prompt: Мы _____ немного и поехали дальше. (We rested a bit and drove on.)
items.explanation: Отдохнули: pf of отдыхать. Brief completed rest before continuing.

items.prompt: Он _____ в телефоне и убрал его. (He fiddled with his phone for a while and put it away.)
items.hint: по- + сидеть = spent a little time (colloquially with phone).
items.explanation: Посидел: по- (for a while) + сидеть. Spent a brief time on the phone.

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: Comprehensive drill on prefix meanings and pure perfectivizers

items.prompt: Мы _____ реку на лодке. (We crossed the river by boat.)
items.promptEnglish: Crossed from one side to the other.
items.explanation: Пере- = across: переплыли (swam/sailed across the river).

items.prompt: Поезд _____ из туннеля. (The train came out of the tunnel.)
items.explanation: Вы- = out: выехал (drove/came out of the tunnel).

items.prompt: Which prefix is a pure perfectivizer in 'прочитать'?
items.hint: Прочитать = read to completion, same core meaning as читать.
items.explanation: Про- in прочитать is a pure perfectivizer. It doesn't add new meaning, just completion.

items.prompt: Он _____ статью и нашёл ошибку. (He reread the article and found a mistake.)
items.explanation: Пере- = again: перечитал (reread). Found the mistake on the second reading.

items.prompt: до- in дочитать means:
items.promptEnglish: What does до- add to читать?
items.hint: до- = up to the end, complete.
items.explanation: До- = to the end/completion: дочитать (finish reading what's left).

items.prompt: вы- in выписать means:
items.promptEnglish: What does вы- add to писать?
items.explanation: Вы- = out: выписать (write out, copy out, extract). Meaning-changing.

items.prompt: под- in подойти means:
items.promptEnglish: What does под- add to идти?
items.explanation: Под- = approach: подойти (walk up to, approach).

categorySorting.instruction: Sort by the meaning of the prefix
